mapper.sql: scoped.shift_template_id, scoped.company_id, scoped.location_id, scoped.template_code, COALESCE( ( SELECT metadata.anchor_ref FROM audit_event metadata WHERE metadata.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_METADATA' AND metadata.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND metadata.action_code = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_NAME_CAPTURED' ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(metadata.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, metadata.occurred_at DESC, metadata.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), scoped.template_code ) AS template_name, CASE WHEN ( SELECT latest.action_code FROM audit_event latest WHERE latest.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND latest.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND latest.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest.policy_version IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CAST(COALESCE(latest.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, latest.occurred_at DESC, latest.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS status, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_event revision_fact WHERE revision_fact.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND revision_fact.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND revision_fact.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_UPDATED', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) ) AS row_version, COALESCE( ( SELECT latest.reason_code FROM audit_event latest WHERE latest.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND latest.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND latest.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_UPDATED', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest.policy_version IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CAST(COALESCE(latest.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, latest.occurred_at DESC, latest.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), '不可变班次 family' ) AS change_reason, scoped.created_by, scoped.created_at, COALESCE( ( SELECT latest.actor_id_ref FROM audit_event latest WHERE latest.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND latest.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND latest.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_UPDATED', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest.policy_version IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CAST(COALESCE(latest.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, latest.occurred_at DESC, latest.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), scoped.created_by ) AS updated_by, COALESCE( ( SELECT latest.occurred_at FROM audit_event latest WHERE latest.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND latest.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND latest.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_UPDATED', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest.policy_version IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CAST(COALESCE(latest.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, latest.occurred_at DESC, latest.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), scoped.created_at ) AS updated_at

version.shift_version_id, version.shift_template_id, version.version_number, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ) THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE ( SELECT state_fact.state FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ) END AS status, version.effective_from, ( SELECT MIN(next_fact.business_effective_from) FROM shift_publication_timeline published_fact JOIN shift_publication_timeline next_fact ON next_fact.shift_template_id = published_fact.shift_template_id AND next_fact.business_effective_from > published_fact.business_effective_from WHERE published_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id AND published_fact.state = 'PUBLISHED' ) AS effective_to, version.time_zone_snapshot, version.segments_json, version.snapshot_digest, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_version lineage WHERE lineage.shift_template_id = version.shift_template_id AND lineage.effective_from = version.effective_from AND lineage.supersedes_shift_version_id IS NOT NULL AND lineage.version_number <= version.version_number ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ) AS row_version, version.change_reason, version.created_by, version.created_at, ( SELECT MIN(state_fact.recorded_at) FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id AND state_fact.state = 'PUBLISHED' ) AS published_at, COALESCE( ( SELECT state_fact.actor_id FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), version.created_by ) AS updated_by, COALESCE( ( SELECT state_fact.recorded_at FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), version.created_at ) AS updated_at

version.shift_version_id AND state_fact.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ) THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE ( SELECT state_fact.state FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = lineage.version_number <= version.version_number AND lineage.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id AND state_fact.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ) AS row_version, version.change_reason, version.created_by, version.created_at, ( SELECT MIN(state_fact.recorded_at) FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id AND state_fact.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND state_fact.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ) AS published_at, COALESCE( ( SELECT state_fact.actor_id FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id AND state_fact.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), version.created_by ) AS updated_by, COALESCE( ( SELECT state_fact.recorded_at FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id AND state_fact.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), version.created_at ) AS updated_at

mapper.select: SELECT FROM shift_template scoped WHERE 1 = 0

SELECT DISTINCT FROM shift_template scoped JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = #{principalId} JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = scoped.company_id WHERE role_assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND (#{companyId} IS NULL OR scoped.company_id = #{companyId}) ORDER BY scoped.template_code, scoped.shift_template_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.shift_template_id) FROM shift_template scoped JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = #{principalId} JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id AND data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = scoped.company_id WHERE role_assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND (#{companyId} IS NULL OR scoped.company_id = #{companyId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event ( event_id, occurred_at, actor_id_ref, actor_type, action_code, resource_type, resource_id_ref, purpose_code, result_code, reason_code, policy_version, after_digest, correlation_id, request_id, event_hash, anchor_ref ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{occurredAt}, #{actorId}, 'LOCAL_ACCOUNT', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_NAME_CAPTURED', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_METADATA', #{shiftId}, 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_NAME', 'SUCCESS', #{reason}, #{resourceVersion}, #{nameDigest}, #{correlationId}, #{requestId}, #{eventHash}, #{templateName} )
mapper.select: SELECT shift_template_id FROM shift_template WHERE shift_template_id = #{shiftId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_template scoped WHERE scoped.shift_template_id = #{row.shiftTemplateId} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_event revision_fact WHERE revision_fact.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND revision_fact.resource_id_ref = scoped.shift_template_id AND revision_fact.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_UPDATED', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) ) = #{expectedVersion}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shift_version ( shift_version_id, shift_template_id, version_number, effective_from, time_zone_snapshot, segments_json, supersedes_shift_version_id, snapshot_digest, change_reason, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{row.shiftVersionId}, #{row.shiftTemplateId}, #{row.versionNumber}, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{row.timeZoneSnapshot}, #{row.segmentsJson}, NULL, #{row.snapshotDigest}, #{row.changeReason}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.createdAt} )

INSERT INTO shift_version ( shift_version_id, shift_template_id, version_number, effective_from, time_zone_snapshot, segments_json, supersedes_shift_version_id, snapshot_digest, change_reason, created_by, created_at ) SELECT #{row.shiftVersionId}, predecessor.shift_template_id, #{row.versionNumber}, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{row.timeZoneSnapshot}, #{row.segmentsJson}, predecessor.shift_version_id, #{row.snapshotDigest}, #{row.changeReason}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.updatedAt} FROM shift_version predecessor WHERE predecessor.shift_version_id = #{predecessorVersionId} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_version lineage WHERE lineage.shift_template_id = predecessor.shift_template_id AND lineage.effective_from = predecessor.effective_from AND lineage.supersedes_shift_version_id IS NOT NULL AND lineage.version_number <= predecessor.version_number ) = #{expectedVersion} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shift_publication_timeline published WHERE published.shift_version_id = predecessor.shift_version_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_version version WHERE version.shift_version_id = #{versionId} AND version.snapshot_digest = #{snapshotDigest} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_version lineage WHERE lineage.shift_template_id = version.shift_template_id AND lineage.effective_from = version.effective_from AND lineage.supersedes_shift_version_id IS NOT NULL AND lineage.version_number <= version.version_number ) = #{expectedVersion} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shift_publication_timeline published WHERE published.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_version version WHERE version.shift_version_id = #{versionId} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_version lineage WHERE lineage.shift_template_id = version.shift_template_id AND lineage.effective_from = version.effective_from AND lineage.supersedes_shift_version_id IS NOT NULL AND lineage.version_number <= version.version_number ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ) = #{expectedVersion} AND ( SELECT state_fact.state FROM shift_publication_timeline state_fact WHERE state_fact.shift_version_id = version.shift_version_id ORDER BY state_fact.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ) = #{expectedStatus}
SELECT shift_publication_timeline_id FROM shift_publication_timeline WHERE shift_template_id = #{shiftId} ORDER BY event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shift_publication_timeline ( shift_publication_timeline_id, shift_template_id, shift_version_id, event_sequence, state, business_effective_from, predecessor_timeline_id, recorded_at, actor_id, request_id ) VALUES ( #{row.timelineId}, #{row.familyId}, #{row.contentId}, #{row.eventSequence}, #{row.state}, #{row.businessEffectiveFrom}, #{row.predecessorTimelineId}, #{row.recordedAt}, #{row.actorId}, #{row.requestId} )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_timeline active_fact JOIN attendance_group_revision revision ON revision.attendance_group_revision_id = active_fact.attendance_group_revision_id WHERE revision.shift_template_id = #{shiftId} AND active_fact.state = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_timeline same_boundary WHERE same_boundary.attendance_group_id = active_fact.attendance_group_id AND same_boundary.business_effective_from = active_fact.business_effective_from AND same_boundary.event_sequence > active_fact.event_sequence ) AND COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(next_fact.business_effective_from) FROM attendance_group_timeline next_fact WHERE next_fact.attendance_group_id = active_fact.attendance_group_id AND ( next_fact.business_effective_from > active_fact.business_effective_from OR ( next_fact.business_effective_from = active_fact.business_effective_from AND next_fact.event_sequence > active_fact.event_sequence ) ) ), CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) ) > #{businessEffectiveFrom} ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
